## Stocks Portfolio Tracker — Feature Planning

**Stack:** Vite + Vue 3 + PWA + Pinia + Node.js (JS) + D3 + PrimeVue

---

### Core Features (first pass)

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | Portfolio overview — total value, day gain/loss, % change |
| **Holdings** | Table of owned stocks — ticker, shares, avg cost, current price, P&L |
| **Add/Edit Position** | Buy/sell transactions, update holdings |
| **Stock Detail** | D3 price chart (line/candlestick), key stats, news feed |
| **Watchlist** | Track stocks you don't own yet |
| **Performance** | D3 charts — portfolio value over time, allocation pie, sector breakdown |
| **Transactions History** | Log of all buys/sells |

---

### D3 Visualization Candidates

- **Line chart** — portfolio value over time
- **Candlestick chart** — individual stock price history
- **Pie/donut** — allocation by stock or sector
- **Bar chart** — top gainers/losers
- **Area chart** — cumulative returns

---

### Node.js Backend

- Proxy to a stock data API (Alpha Vantage, Finnhub, Yahoo Finance?)
- Store user portfolio data (file-based JSON or SQLite?)
- Auth? Single user (just yours) or multi-user?

---

### Questions to shape the plan

1. **Data source** — do you have an API key already (Finnhub, Alpha Vantage, etc.)? Or want to mock data first?
2. **Auth** — personal use only (no login) or multi-user?
3. **Storage** — lightweight (JSON/SQLite) or a real DB (PostgreSQL)?
4. **Real-time** — live price updates via WebSocket, or periodic polling?
5. **D3 priority** — which chart matters most to you?
6. **Mobile-first** — PWA installable on phone as primary use case?
